To determine why the Service Provider is not correctly tracking these requests, please provide the SP request logs covering the time of the failed attempts.

claims.text: The SAML assertion has expired as it is past the NotOnOrAfter timestamp.
The SAML signature is valid and matches the pinned trusted certificate.

fix_steps: Check the system clock on your Identity Provider (IdP) to ensure it is synchronized with NTP.
Verify the assertion lifetime settings in your IdP configuration to ensure the NotOnOrAfter window provides sufficient time for the assertion to be delivered and processed.
Investigate potential network latency or delays in the browser redirect process that may be causing the assertion to arrive after its expiration time.
parsed.summary: Your SSO login attempt failed because the SAML assertion provided by your Identity Provider has expired. The assertion's validity window, defined by the NotOnOrAfter condition, has already passed by the time it reached our service.
